title: UPDATE: Together's Post-Training B200 GPU Rates Drop to $9 an Hour for AI Fine-Tuning
summary:
The AI infrastructure provider has added the MiniMax M3.1 Flash model to its suite of supported large language models and adjusted its hardware pricing to attract more developers to its custom training service. Together now charges $9 per Nvidia B200 GPU hour for the first eight weeks of use on its Post-Training platform, a reduction from the previous $11 hourly rate.

The platform enables companies to use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to convert open-weight models into proprietary tools while keeping the training loops in their own Python code. Deel's data science team utilized the service to fine-tune its Pangaea K1 model using more than 43,500 pages of knowledge, while the hiring firm Jack & Jill developed a candidate prediction model that matched the quality of closed-source AI alternatives.
